items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Amasty extension (leading to RCE)
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. [cite: 11 (from initial search)]

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw (CVE-2026-53787) in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. [cite: 11 (from initial search)]

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-45247) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. [cite: 9 (from initial search)]

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to arbitrary code execution
items.summary: A critical Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVE-2026-34686) in Adobe Commerce could enable arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal vulnerability allowing arbitrary file system writes
items.summary: A critical Path Traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-34653) in Adobe Commerce allows arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to security feature bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-34646) in Adobe Commerce allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access. [cite: 4, 6 (from initial search)]

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to security feature bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-34645) in Adobe Commerce could lead to a security feature bypass.

items.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) enabling security feature bypass
items.summary: A Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability (CVE-2026-34647) in Adobe Commerce could enable a security feature bypass.

items.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerabilities leading to application denial-of-service
items.summary: Multiple uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-34648 through CVE-2026-34652) in Adobe Commerce could cause application denial-of-service.

items.title: Vulnerable third-party component dependency (Denial of Service)
items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability (CVE-2026-34654) in Adobe Commerce stems from a dependency on a vulnerable third-party component. [cite: 4, 7 (from initial search)]

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: An additional Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVE-2026-34655) was addressed in Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Improper access controls
items.summary: An improper access controls vulnerability (CVE-2026-34656) was addressed in Adobe Commerce.
